samples.summary: getDateFormat/setDateFormat touch localStorage unguarded; every documents-list date cell now reads it during render
samples.evidence: `getDateFormat()` (packages/frontend/src/lib/date-format-preference.ts:32) and `setDateFormat()` (:38) call `localStorage` with no try/catch. `getDateFormat` is the `getSnapshot` of `useSyncExternalStore` (:56) and is therefore invoked on every render of `DateCell` in document-list.tsx:241, i.e. twice per row. In browsers where storage access throws (SecurityError under blocked third-party/partitioned storage or strict private modes) the whole documents list render now throws, where before this change it did not touch storage at all. The repo's own convention guards for exactly this: packages/frontend/src/api/analytics.ts:47-58 ('localStorage access throws (SecurityError) when cookies are disabled…') and packages/frontend/src/components/text-formatting/font-recents.ts:23-26. Fix belongs on the new module: wrap both accessors and fall back to DEFAULT_DATE_FORMAT. Confidence is low only because components/theme-provider.tsx:41 already reads localStorage unguarded at app root, so such a browser may already fail earlier.

samples.summary: Other consumers of formatRelativeTime ignore the new preference, so 'Exact date' is only honoured in the documents table
samples.evidence: Out-of-diff consumers still call `formatRelativeTime` directly and are unaffected by the new setting: packages/frontend/src/components/notifications/notification-item.tsx:47, packages/frontend/src/app/files/generic-file-view.tsx:41, and the comments surfaces via the separate `@/lib/utils` copy (components/comments/components/CommentThreadCard.tsx:103, CommentSidePanel.tsx:107, OrphanedCard.tsx:42). A user who selects 'Exact date' still sees relative times there. The Settings copy scopes the option to 'document lists' and docs/tasks/active/20260812-date-display-format-todo.md:58-61 declares this out of scope, so this is an accepted inconsistency rather than a break — noted so the consumers are on the record.

samples.summary: Storage key naming diverges from the existing per-browser preference keys
samples.evidence: New key is `wafflebase-date-format` (date-format-preference.ts:17) while sibling preferences use dot namespacing: `wafflebase.board.grid` / `wafflebase.board.grid-snap` (packages/frontend/src/app/board/board-grid.ts:222,249). Purely cosmetic — nothing reads the other keys generically — but a shared prefix convention makes future bulk clearing/migration easier.

verdict.reason: The described code exists exactly as claimed (date-format-preference.ts:32 and :38 access localStorage with no try/catch; :56 uses getDateFormat as the useSyncExternalStore snapshot; document-list.tsx:241 invokes it per date cell), so this is not a not-present refutation. It is refuted as out-of-scope for the blast-radius lens. A repo-wide Grep for useDateFormat|getDateFormat|setDateFormat|date-format-preference yields only three production references, all part of this same change: document-list.tsx:96,241; settings/page.tsx:16-19,26,71; and a type-only import at document-list-utils.ts:3. Every one uses the new API in its new form, so there is no unupdated caller, no changed signature/return shape/nullability, no removed or renamed export, no violated invariant another module assumes, and no protected operation reachable by a second entry point bypassing a new guard. Both ends of the alleged failure sit inside the diff: the unguarded storage read is in the newly added module, and the render path that reaches it (DateCell) is the diff's own edit, importing the new module at document-list.tsx:96. The finding itself says the fix belongs on the new module, i.e. it is statable without leaving the diff, which this lens explicitly defers to the correctness lens. I also checked the one variant that would be in my lane, a new module pulled into a context lacking localStorage (SSR/node), and found none: the only non-component importer takes the DateDisplayFormat type only. Consistent with this, the repo's review artifacts show correctness and security already carrying the identical issue, so it stays on the gate via the correct lane.
